description: Synthesize the narration of every scene (or only sceneIds). Each scene is said in its voiceTone (pitch, pace, energy, pauses, breaths and timbre), with *stressed* words and ... hesitations from the narration. Returns a voice-only preview. To change how one line sounds: update_scene with voiceTone or markup, then generate_voice with sceneIds.

voice.description: See list_voices. Default: an English female voice (a French one for French projects).

name: generate_voice
title: Generate the voice
